citation: Qi Yan, Lin Wu-Qiang, Liao Bin, et al. Blood plasma metagenomic next-generation sequencing for identifying pathogens of febrile neutropenia in acute leukemia patients. Scientific Reports, 2023.

population.population_description: Acute leukemia patients with febrile neutropenia (temperature >38.3°C or twice >38.0°C >1h and neutrophil count <500/mm3) undergoing paired plasma mNGS and blood culture within 24 h

neutropenic_status: FN definition: 'oral temperature > 38.3 °C or twice consecutive > 38.0 °C for more than 1 h and neutrophil count < 500/mm3'

index_test.platform_or_panel: plasma cfDNA mNGS on MGISEQ-2000 (MGI); Genskey kits; ~12,000-genome SNAP database

reference_standard: Final clinical diagnosis of infectious pathogen at discharge: 'The final diagnosis of the infectious pathogen at the time of discharge was the gold standard', based on comprehensive judgment of three experienced senior physicians

diagnostic_yield.basis: mNGS diagnostic positivity 25/37 (67.6%) vs blood culture 7/37 (18.9%) (p<0.05). Versus final clinical diagnosis in blood samples: sensitivity 100.00%, specificity 40.00%, PPV 28.00%, NPV 100.00%; agreement of mNGS and BC 51.35% (19/37). Of 14 clinically approved pathogens, 9 detected only by mNGS and 5 by both mNGS and BC. Raw 2x2 counts not published (PPV 28% of 25 mNGS-positives implies 7 TP; not explicitly stated).

additional_yield_vs_conventional: Of 37 infections, 6 (16.22%) diagnosed by both BC and mNGS, 18 (48.65%) by mNGS only, 12 (32.43%) negative by both; mNGS detected 9 of 14 final pathogens that BC missed

quality_flags.overlap_risk: Same blood draw split for BC and mNGS; clinicians adjudicating final diagnosis were not blinded to mNGS results (incorporation bias); paper has internal inconsistencies (6+18=24 vs reported 25 mNGS-positive patients)

quadas2_notes: Sensitivity/specificity reported vs discharge clinical diagnosis but no raw TP/FP/FN/TN counts; derived counts would be inconsistent (PPV 28% x 25 = 7 TP, but '6 diagnosed by both BC and mNGS' and sensitivity 100% + NPV 100% constraints do not reconcile cleanly), so no 2x2 built. Note text/figure counting discrepancies.

evidence_quotes.quote: We retrospectively reviewed 37 AL patients with FN and compared the results of mNGS with blood culture (BC) and the clinical features of the mNGS-positive group and the mNGS-negative group.
From February 2020 to February 2023, a total of 37 AL patients with FN were enrolled in the Affiliated People's Hospital of Fujian University of Traditional Chinese Medicine.
The diagnostic positivity rate of mNGS (25/37, 67.6%) was significantly higher than that of BC (7/37, 18.9%), and the difference was statistically significant (p < 0.05).
The sensitivity and specificity were 100.00% and 40.00%, respectively. The positive prediction value (PPV) and negative prediction value (NPV) were 28.00% and 100.00%, respectively.
Of 37 infections, 6 (16.22%) were diagnosed by both BC and mNGS, 18 (48.65%) by mNGS only, and 12 (32.43%) were negative by both BC and mNGS
A total of 14 detected pathogens were the final clinical diagnosis, of which 9 strains were detected only by mNGS and 5 strains were detected by both mNGS and BC.
The final diagnosis of the infectious pathogen at the time of discharge was the gold standard.
meeting the criteria for FN: oral temperature > 38.3 °C or twice consecutive > 38.0 °C for more than 1 h and neutrophil count < 500/mm3

exclusion_reason: No raw 2x2 counts; derived counts internally inconsistent; n=37 modest.
